action_ja: 脚を下にした穏やかな降下
prompt_en: The exact same Mio makes a slow controlled vertical descent while staying upright. Both legs remain directly below the torso with knees only slightly softened, arms remain low and open a little for balance, and the teal feet approach an unseen floor without touching it. Keep both circular eye lenses warm amber at exactly the same color and brightness for all three seconds; do not blink, dim, recolor, or close either eye. The rounded triangular head stays level and faces forward. Keep every ivory, deep-teal, graphite, and coral-orange part unchanged. No falling, tumbling, running, wing, jetpack, flame, exhaust, speech, or redesign. Locked camera and neutral studio background.
